== C. SetTab(string tabName) private void (BizManBusiness.cs:294-344) EVERY OP ==
1. Transform t = containers.Find(tabName); if (t == null) return;   // SILENT no-op if container missing
2. if (_currentContainer != null) { _currentContainer.gameObject.SetActive(false); _currentTabText.color = _defaultTabColor; }
3. _selectedTab = tabName;
4. _currentContainer = t; _currentContainer.gameObject.SetActive(true);   // activating container => its MonoBehaviours OnEnable fire
5. _currentTabText = menu.Find(tabName).GetComponent TextMeshProUGUI ;   // menu child MUST carry a TextMeshProUGUI directly
6. _currentTabText.color = GlobalReferences.Instance.colors.white;
7. splitterIndicator.Set(_currentTabText.GetComponent RectTransform );
8. if (tabName == "RealEstate") { businessInfo off; buildingInfo.ShowInfo(); } else { buildingInfo off; businessInfo.SetActive(tabName != "Presentation"); }
9. switch (tabName) { "Insight"/"InventoryPricing"/"Schedule"/"Settings"/"Marketing" -> that sub-view.RefreshData(); }  -- NO case for PricingManagers/LogisticsManagers/PurchasingAgents/HRManagers/Headhunters; those refresh only via their container OnEnable.
=> A mod tab whose button+container are correctly-named children of menu/containers is fully serviced by stock SetTab. NO SetTab patch needed.

== G. HARMONY PATCH PLAN (order + parenting) ==
Mod compiles against the game assembly. BizManBusiness is GLOBAL namespace (confirmed: reflection dump "static field BizManBusiness (Business)k__BackingField"; ScheduleHelper.cs:29 "public static BizManBusiness Business").
Cache once: fMenu=AccessTools.Field(typeof(BizManBusiness),"menu"); fContainers=...("containers"); fTabs=...("_tabs"); mSetTab=AccessTools.Method(typeof(BizManBusiness),"SetTab",new[]{typeof(string)}). splitterIndicator NOT needed.

PATCH 1 (REQUIRED): [HarmonyPatch(typeof(BizManBusiness),"SetUpTabs")] static void Postfix(BizManBusiness __instance):
  a. if (!modEnabled || !BuildGate.Ok) return;
  b. reg = __instance.buildingRegistration; isHq = reg != null and reg.RentedByPlayer and reg.businessTypeName == "ba:businesstype_headquarters";
  c. menu/containers/tabs = fMenu/fContainers/fTabs.GetValue(__instance);
  d. foreach modTabId in {"StoreManagers","TeamLeaders"}:
       btn = menu.Find(modTabId);

                   if (!tabs.Contains(modTabId)) tabs.Insert(tabs.IndexOf("PurchasingAgents")+1, modTabId);
                   btn.gameObject.SetActive(true); }             // stock L249-252 loop already hid it -> re-show
       else { if (btn!=null) btn.gameObject.SetActive(false); }   // do NOT add to _tabs off-HQ
  Rationale: SetUpTabs is the single choke point (from RefreshData L348 -> OnEnable L177 / Open L184 / BizManPresentation.cs:190,844 / BizManSettings.cs:173,376, AND directly from the business-switch handler L165; grep: exactly 3 "SetUpTabs" hits, all in BizManBusiness.cs, no external callers). == J. FRAGILITY + BUILD GATE ==
menu, containers, splitterIndicator, businessNameDropdown : [SerializeField] private (L33-48) -- reflection-only; rename breaks silently -> wrap each AccessTools.Field/Method in a null check + one-time Debug.LogError + disable the UI feature (keep headless supervision running). SetTab (L294), SetUpTabs (L203) : private. SetInitialTab, RefreshData : public. _tabs : private List string (L114).
Tab identity = GameObject .name; menu-button visual order = sibling index -- both authored in the BizManBusiness prefab -> clone a live sibling ("PurchasingAgents") rather than fabricate. Menu-button prototype has Button + TextMeshProUGUI + TextLocalizationComponent all on ONE GameObject. Stock Awake loop (L121-144) wires listeners on EXISTING children only. SetUpTabs trailing loop (L249-252) sets menu-child active iff _tabs.Contains(name) and runs BEFORE the postfix -> postfix must both Insert into _tabs AND SetActive(true). Container GOs default inactive; only SetTab toggles them -- Instantiating the (inactive) "PurchasingAgents" container yields an inactive clone whose PurchasingAgentsPlanList/PurchasingAgentPlanUI Awake has NOT run -> safe to DestroyImmediate those scripts before first activation if using a clone-and-strip content approach.
BizManSettings.cs:207/212 wipes hidden HQ plans on business-type change; Player.SaveSystem.CompatibilityFixes.* / DeleteHiddenPlansFromNonHQBusinesses.cs and FixBrokenSchedule.cs touch the GAME plan lists -- mod state in GameInstance.modData is untouched -> keep StoreManagerPlan in modData, do NOT inject a real plan type (DECISIONS D9). Harmony => Mono build; private void methods with real bodies + multiple call sites are not realistically inlined; still, do not depend on patching the small SetInitialTab (we don't).
Build gate: GameVersion.GetCurrent().buildNumber (GameVersion.cs:38 field; L46 GetCurrent() -> Resources.Load GameVersion ("Versioning/Current")); or SaveGameManager.Current.buildNumberAtStart (CustomerEntriesCalculatorRetail.cs:17); modInfo.targetBuildNumber surfaced by the game uploader (UploadModPanel.cs:416-427). Pin a tested window (e.g. 3600..3799); outside window OR any reflection handle null -> skip ALL BizMan-tab patches, log once, keep the headless weekly-restock/supervision layer alive.
Runtime accessor without patching (for the tab view code): UI.Smartphone.Apps.BizMan.BizMan.business (BizMan.cs:39) via InstanceBehavior UIs .Instance.fullMenu.bizMan.business -- the path every vanilla plan list uses. ScheduleHelper.Business (ScheduleHelper.cs:29) exists but is only populated while the Schedule tab is loaded.

feasibility: needs Harmony — REQUIRED: one Postfix on BizManBusiness.SetUpTabs (private void, global-namespace type in the BigAmbitions assembly): (a) lazily build the mod menu button + content container as name-matched children of the private [SerializeField] menu / containers Transforms, (b) insert the tab id into the private List string _tabs when buildingRegistration.businessTypeName == ba:businesstype_headquarters, (c) SetActive(true) the button (the stock L249-252 loop already hid it). OPTIONAL: a Postfix on BizManBusiness.Awake to pre-build (removes a one-open flicker). NOT NEEDED: any patch on SetTab (stock SetTab fully services a correctly-named child — its switch has no manager-tab case, content refresh rides the container GameObject OnEnable) or SetInitialTab. The mod button onClick invokes private BizManBusiness.SetTab(string) via AccessTools reflection. NO asset bundle — clone a live sibling menu button (PurchasingAgents) for styling/RectTransform/TextLocalizationComponent; build the container content at runtime with uGUI (ScrollRect + VerticalLayoutGroup) exactly as PurchasingAgentsPlanList/HrManagersPlanList do. Gate every patch on GameVersion.GetCurrent().buildNumber within a tested window and on non-null reflection handles; on failure skip the UI and keep the headless supervision layer alive.
